description: This file defines the 'Policy' class for managing device administration policies, including password requirements, and contains an inner class 'PolicyAdmin' extending DeviceAdminReceiver to handle admin events.

classes.name: Policy
classes.description: Manages device security policies such as password quality, length, and uppercase requirements, and handles device admin activation status.

classes.name: Policy.PolicyAdmin
classes.description: Inner class extending DeviceAdminReceiver to handle device admin events like deactivation.

methods.name: Policy
methods.description: Constructor initializing policy parameters and device admin components.

methods.name: saveToLocal
methods.description: Saves password policy parameters to shared preferences.

methods.name: readFromLocal
methods.description: Reads password policy parameters from shared preferences.

methods.name: getPasswordMinUpperCase
methods.description: Returns current minimum uppercase letter requirement.

methods.name: getPolicyAdmin
methods.description: Returns the ComponentName representing the device admin.

methods.name: isAdminActive
methods.description: Checks if the device admin is currently active.

methods.name: isActivePasswordSufficient
methods.description: Checks if the current password meets security requirements.

methods.name: isDeviceSecured
methods.description: Determines if device is secured with active admin and password policy.

methods.name: configurePolicy
methods.description: Applies the current password policies to the device.
